repo.name: Wird
repo.description: Self-hosted F-Droid repo for Wird, a minimal daily Quran reading habit tracker. Add this repo URL in the F-Droid client to get automatic updates.

apps.description:
Wird helps you build a daily habit of reading the Quran. Tracks your
reading streak, session count, and time spent reading - no lifetime
completion percentage, no invented stats, just what the app can
honestly know about your reading.

Uses an authentic Indo-Pak Nastaleeq Quran text and font.
apps.summary: A minimal daily Quran reading habit tracker
